evals.prompt: Run step-mode quality gate check after implementing the user login API endpoint slice.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs verified build and test commands for the slice, checks inputs and secrets, and outputs structured gate report.
expectations: Executes verified build and lint commands recorded in project context
Evaluates slice changes against Code and Backend security check groups
Generates gate report via gate_report.py script with status evidence

evals.prompt: Perform final release gate audit before deploying release v1.0.0 of our web application.
evals.expected_output: The skill performs comprehensive check matrix review across all 7 categories and issues final gate verdict.
expectations: Audits all 7 check categories (Code, Security, UI, Backend, DB, Deployment, Docs)
Assigns clear statuses with empirical evidence or N/A justifications
Marks gate status as FAILED if any check fails, never claiming everything is perfect

evals.prompt: Check quality gate for a release containing custom crypto and payment integration changes.
evals.expected_output: The skill tags crypto and payment checks with REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW status and presents evidence.
expectations: Labels payment flows and crypto design checks as REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW
Applies verified evidence rules to code and test build checks
Renders gate audit report using python scripts/gate_report.py
